theme: A travel day north, kids in Florida.
greeting: The morning's yours before you fly to Portland this afternoon, Dan. The girls are with Jen, so Maine is the backdrop from tonight.

needsAttention.title: Send ICGN your times and bio
needsAttention.detail: Claudia at ICGN is scheduling the Plenary 7 planning call for the panel you're moderating and needs a range of your availability across the weeks of Oct 19 and 26, plus a short bio and headshot for the site and agenda.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December destination
needsAttention.detail: Your own Sept 30 decision date has slipped and the book-by is Oct 15 — pick either a domestic shortlist or refundable international for the three weeks with all four girls before holiday inventory thins.

needsAttention.title: Book the Portland holiday SUV
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder heads south this month, so Christmas week in Maine has no six-seater; a refundable full-size SUV out of PWM over the holidays sells out early, which is why this one bites.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive window opens today
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 gap to drive the Pathfinder from Portland down to St Pete starts now — the one hotel night can be booked once you and Mike set the two travel days.

schedule.title: Flight to Portland
schedule.detail: Tampa (TPA) to Portland, landing around 4:55 PM

flagged.title: Warm intro to a Montreal recruiter
flagged.detail: Andrew flagged a board-focused headhunter in Montreal he thinks you should reach out to.

flagged.title: Amex October statement is ready
flagged.detail: Your October statement posted with a note to review important notices.

flagged.title: DIRA/DIBA materials for the Oct 25 meeting
flagged.detail: David Wetherbee sent the packet ahead of the Oct 25 session in Maine.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, promotions, and job-alert digests.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply this morning.

recipe.title: Fricassée of chanterelles
recipe.why: Autumn is peak chanterelle season, when wild mushrooms are at their earthy best.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Place the Portland house order — bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: A quiet morning at home before the airport — the last clear stretch of the day.
Most of the afternoon disappears into the flight up to Portland.
You land into Maine, with a 7 AM call with Mike's team sitting on the far side of the night.
